rules.title: Invalid hreflang value
rules.description: hreflang values must be ISO 639-1 language codes, optionally followed by an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region (e.g. en, en-GB), or x-default. Invalid values are ignored.

sources.title: Google: Localized versions of your pages

rules.title: hreflang without return link
rules.description: Page A lists page B as an alternate, but B does not link back to A. Google ignores non-reciprocal hreflang annotations.
rules.fix: Add the reciprocal hreflang link on every alternate page.

sources.title: Google: Localized versions of your pages

rules.title: hreflang set without self-reference
rules.description: The page declares hreflang alternates but does not include itself. Each language version should list itself and all alternates.

sources.title: Google: Localized versions of your pages

rules.title: hreflang points to a non-200 or non-canonical URL
rules.description: hreflang alternates should be canonical, indexable 200 URLs; redirects and errors break the cluster.
rules.fix: Point alternates at the final canonical URLs.

sources.title: Google: Localized versions of your pages
Google: How to specify a canonical URL

rules.title: hreflang uses relative URLs
rules.description: Google requires fully-qualified URLs (including scheme) in hreflang annotations.
rules.fix: Use absolute URLs in hreflang links.

sources.title: Google: Localized versions of your pages

rules.title: hreflang cluster without x-default
rules.description: x-default designates the fallback page for unmatched languages. Optional but recommended for language selectors / global pages.
rules.fix: Add hreflang="x-default" pointing to the fallback page.

sources.title: Google: Localized versions of your pages

rules.title: Missing html lang attribute
rules.description: The <html> element has no lang attribute. W3C recommends declaring the language for accessibility (screen readers, translation). Google does not use it for language detection; Bing uses language signals.

sources.title: Google: Localized versions of your pages
